title: Add accessible loading empty and error states
description: Make representative loading, empty, degraded, success, and error states perceivable and understandable without relying on color or transient spinners alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading state exposes a textual/assistive status and does not trap focus or duplicate announcements
Empty state explains what is missing and offers the next valid action where applicable
Error state identifies the failed operation and recovery action without exposing internals/secrets
States are localized and tested on dashboard, nodes, tunnels, port-forward, users, audit, tools, and settings
Browser checks verify text/role/state changes for representative transitions

steps.description: Use browser/DOM checks to expose missing status text, unlabeled loading controls, or color-only errors on representative views.
Read shared status/toast/empty components and representative views; map existing loading/error branches and messages.
Add localized text/roles/live regions or state classes only where evidence fails, preserving existing API behavior.
Run browser checks in en/fa, typecheck, lint, and custom tests; record route coverage and limitations.

technicalNotes: Use `aria-live` sparingly for noisy/repeated updates; do not announce every polling tick.
